headline_original: US Services PMI at 55.4%; August 2026 ISM Services PMI Report
headline_cs: Americké služby zrychlily: ISM Services 55,4 a cenové tlaky znovu vzrostly
summary_cs: ISM Services za srpen vzrostl na 55,4 proti odhadu 54,1 a předchozím 54,1. Nové objednávky vyskočily na 60,9 a Prices Paid na 72,6, zatímco zaměstnanost zůstala v kontrakci na 47,8. Kombinace silného růstu a vysokých cen je krátkodobě jestřábí pro sazby a negativní hlavně pro duration-sensitive akcie a drahé kovy, i když slabší zaměstnanost signál částečně tlumí.

predictions.mechanism: Stronger growth plus hotter services prices raises the risk of higher Treasury yields and a more restrictive Fed path, directly pressuring long-duration technology valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Treasury yields and September hike odds fail to rise or reverse lower because markets focus on weak services employment and/or dovish Fed guidance.

predictions.mechanism: The growth beat is positive, but the jump in Prices Paid to 72.6 keeps inflation and rate-hike risk elevated, raising the discount rate for the broad index.
predictions.invalidation: Bond yields decline despite the report or subsequent Fed commentary explicitly leans against a hike and dominates the inflation signal.

predictions.mechanism: A stronger-than-expected ISM with elevated prices paid can lift nominal/real yields and the dollar, increasing gold's opportunity cost.
predictions.invalidation: Yields and DXY stay weak or fall because markets prioritize the employment contraction and Waller's dovish conditional stance.

predictions.mechanism: Higher rate expectations weigh on precious metals, while resilient growth offers some industrial-demand offset for silver.
predictions.invalidation: Dollar and yields weaken materially or industrial-growth optimism overwhelms the rates channel.

predictions.mechanism: Stronger services demand supports cyclicals, while hotter prices and higher-rate risk offset that benefit for the broad blue-chip index.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive bond-yield move makes either the growth-positive or rate-negative channel dominant.
